dataset_name: BIS MVP Structured Dataset for SIH 2026 AI/RAG Prototype
scope: Beginner-friendly MVP dataset for product-to-standard mapping and BIS service routing. It is not legal advice and should not be used as the final authority for compliance decisions.
verification_policy: Rows marked Verified are copied/summarized from official BIS pages accessed on 2026-08-27. Rows marked as needing verification should trigger retrieval of the official BIS page/QCO before final answer.
recommended_rag_use: Index each standards row as a separate document chunk using product_category, standard_number, title, certification_scheme, applicability, notes, and source_url.
Index each service row separately for questions about how to apply, verify a mark, or choose a BIS route.
Return source_url in every model answer. Do not answer certification yes/no if the product is not present in the retrieved official-source records.
For high-stakes compliance answers, route to official BIS page/QCO and say verification is required.

fields.standard_number: Indian Standard number or standard family exactly as listed by BIS where available.
fields.title: Official title or lightly normalized title from BIS source.
fields.product_category: Product/category phrase useful for search and embeddings.
fields.applicability: Plain-English scope based on the BIS listing.
fields.certification_scheme: BIS scheme or hallmarking context only when supported by official source.
fields.verification_status: Evidence label showing whether the row is source-verified.

services.description: BIS Scheme I is the product certification scheme for use of the ISI mark.
services.user_need_supported: Explain how a manufacturer can get a BIS licence for an ISI-marked product.
services.notes: Use this for workflow explanation, not product-specific legal conclusions.

services.description: BIS lists Scheme IV as a product certification scheme for grant of Certificate of Conformity.
services.user_need_supported: Answer questions about Certificate of Conformity route where applicable.
services.notes: Dataset does not map Scheme IV product scope; retrieve official Scheme IV product list for final scope.

services.description: BIS Scheme II page lists Electronics and IT Goods under Compulsory Registration Scheme for self declaration of conformity.
services.user_need_supported: Map electronics products to CRS standard numbers and explain registration-mark context.
services.source_name: BIS Scheme II Registration Scheme product list
services.notes: For final answers, cite product row and latest notification/amendment.

services.description: BIS states certification is generally voluntary, but for some products central government makes compliance compulsory through QCOs.
services.user_need_supported: Decide whether to search compulsory certification lists before answering product questions.
services.notes: Assistant should say 'check current QCO/list' for compliance-critical answers.

services.description: BIS Care App supports verification of licence details, HUID, CRS R-number, standards lookup, labs/offices, and complaints.
services.user_need_supported: Guide consumers to verify ISI mark, hallmark HUID, or CRS R-number.
services.notes: This is a strong MVP workflow: answer plus next action in BIS Care App.

services.description: BIS FAQ says hallmarking records purity/fineness of precious metal articles; gold and silver are under hallmarking in India.
services.user_need_supported: Answer gold/silver jewellery hallmarking questions and route users to HUID verification.
services.notes: For mandatory district coverage, retrieve latest hallmarking order/amendment.

services.description: BIS FMCS grants licence to foreign manufacturers for use of Standard Mark on products conforming to Indian Standards, except notified Electronics and IT Goods under MeitY CRS.
services.user_need_supported: Explain foreign manufacturer route for BIS licence.
services.notes: For FMCS application mode, also retrieve the how-to-apply page.

services.description: BIS says FMCS applications can be submitted online through Manakonline; hard-copy/offline applications accepted only up to 31 May 2026, and from 1 June 2026 only online applications are accepted.
services.notes: Date-sensitive fact verified on 2026-08-27; re-check before future demos.

services.description: BIS FAQ says a manufacturer needs manufacturing infrastructure, process controls, quality control, testing capability, and product conformity to the relevant Indian Standard.
services.user_need_supported: Answer beginner questions on what is needed before applying for a BIS licence.
services.notes: Keep as general guidance; product-specific manuals may add more requirements.

services.description: BIS FAQ directs manufacturers to search for the Indian Standard against a product on Manakonline, or query the concerned technical department if not found.
services.user_need_supported: When product mapping is missing, tell the user where to search or escalate.
services.notes: Use as fallback when the MVP dataset has no confident match.
